### Veterinary Oncologist Online Consultation Service

The Pet Oncologist is a family-owned, independent veterinary oncology consultancy led by Dr. Cat Chan—the only veterinary oncologist worldwide to be board-certified by both the American (ACVIM) and Australian (ANZCVS) colleges, with specialist training and credentials in both countries. Based in Brisbane, we support veterinarians across Australia and internationally. We specialise in remote, evidence-based pet cancer advice, education, and ongoing support for veterinarians—wherever you are.

Our expert veterinary oncology consultation services are available Monday to Friday, 9 am to 3 pm AEST.

Why Choose The Pet Oncologist?

We believe every patient and veterinary team deserves individual attention. Each case receives a meticulous, personalised review and a detailed, evidence-based consultation report. We take the time to provide the highest level of scientific evidence and practical recommendations, tailored to your patient, client, and clinic. To learn more about our educational offerings and upcoming events, please visit our Education and Events page.

In Brisbane, we offer a dedicated Mobile Oncology Ultrasound Service exclusively for veterinary clinics. All bookings, reports, and communications are managed through the referring veterinary team.

For Pet Owners:
If you are seeking specialist advice for your pet with cancer, please ask your veterinarian to contact us. In compliance with veterinary licensing legislation and legal requirements, we cannot provide direct advice to pet owners or the public. Are online consultations are exclusively for veterinarians, who can examine, wnediagnose, and treat your pet in person.

We have compiled a list of Frequently Asked Questions and Useful Links for pet owners who wish to learn more about cancer in pets.

Feel free to visit our Gallery and Blog where we share inspiring stories of pets with cancer and regular updates on advances in veterinary oncology—created especially for veterinarians and veterinary teams.

We’d love to learn more about you, your clinic, and how we can support your veterinary oncology needs.

Please email us (info@thepetoncologist.com)—our consultancy services exist to support you and your patients, and we want you to feel confident in your clinical decisions by utilising our services, education, and events.

Thank you for trusting us with your cases. We promise never to take that trust for granted, and we are here to help you every step of the way.

# Oncology Vet Telehealth Appointments Specialist cancer advice, now available via video consult. Connect with our oncology vet team remotely for timely, compassionate care.

## Veterinary Oncology Specialists

### Oncology Vet Telehealth Appointments Now Available

MARS understands how important timely vet cancer care is for pets and peace of mind for their families. We are proud to now offer oncology vet telehealth appointments with our veterinary oncologist, providing expert guidance, treatment planning, and compassionate support—no matter where you are.

What Is an Oncology Vet Telehealth Appointment?

An oncology vet telehealth consultation allows pet owners and referring veterinarians to connect directly with our oncology vet team via secure video conferencing. Whether you’re seeking a second opinion, guidance on diagnostics, or a detailed treatment plan, our telehealth service brings expert vet cancer care closer to home. Following each consult a detailed individualised plan is created and sent out to pet owner and referring veterinarian.

Who Can Benefit?

  * Pet Owners looking for expert advice, second opinions, or help understanding their pet’s diagnosis and treatment options.
  * Referring Veterinarians wanting to collaborate on complex cases or access specialist input for their patients in regional or remote areas.

What to Expect

  * A comprehensive review of your pet’s history, diagnostics, and current condition.
  * Clear explanations of diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment options.
  * Collaboration with your primary vet to create a cohesive care plan.
  * Ongoing support and guidance through your pet’s cancer journey following referral to MARS.

How to Book

Appointments can be scheduled via our Melbourne animal cancer care team. Please email your patient’s history, and test results to our team and we will be in touch to will your client for a telehealth appointment with our veterinary oncologist. At present, these are scheduled every Thursday and Friday.

### Expert vet cancer care support is just a video call away—Get started today!

## The Pet Oncologist - Online Pet Oncology Service

### DR. CATHERINE CHAN BVSC (HONS I) FANZCVS (VETERINARY ONCOLOGY) DIPLOMATE ACVIM (ONCOLOGY)

### BOARD-CERTIFIED & REGISTERED SPECIALIST IN VETERINARY ONCOLOGY Q4941

I graduated in 2009 from The University of Queensland with a Bachelor of Veterinary Science. I started my veterinary career by completing a small animal rotating internship at Veterinary Specialist Services (Brisbane), followed shortly by working in small animal emergency and general practice. I moved to Sydney in 2012 to complete a three-year veterinary oncology residency program at the Animal Referral Hospital (Homebush). Between 2016 and 2019, I consulted at Queensland Veterinary Specialists (Brisbane). I have also spent some time in the USA at the University of Missouri and Colorado State University. I am a board-certified specialist by both the Australian and New Zealand College of Veterinary Scientists (ANZCVS) and American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine (ACVIM) in veterinary oncology.

I offer veterinarians online pet cancer advice and remote support (Monday to Friday, 9 am to 3 pm AEST) to provide the best possible cancer care and recommendations for all species of pets with cancer. My online veterinary oncology consulting service is available to all veterinarians globally, with all reports supplied within 1 to 3 business days. For further information please click ‘Consultations’, ‘Frequently Asked Questions’, or ‘Information Brochure’.

I also provide ‘Education’and ‘Handouts’ for veterinarians (and veterinary students) who wish to obtain CPD points and learn more about cancer in pets. Additionally, I host regular 'Events and Workshops' throughout the year.

For pet owners seeking specialist advice for their pet with cancer, please ask your veterinarian to contact me.

# About Us

### Online Oncologist is a bespoke consulting service that is tailored specifically for primary care clinicians and their cancer patients. Recognising that there are often limited clear guidelines in veterinary oncology, expert guidance is provided through the available diagnostic and treatment options that are informed by the most recent research. At the same time, we are sensitive to the financial constraints faced by many pet owners and the pressures within busy veterinary settings, so our advice is, above all, practical.

### We offer a range of tailor-made solutions designed to meet the unique requirements of each case, helping veterinarians to enhance their patient care without over-extending their resources. You will be empowered with the knowledge to confidently manage oncology cases and communicate with your clients.

### Dr Sonya Yu BVSc MANZCVS (Small Animal Medicine, Veterinary Emergency and Critical Care) FANZCVS (Veterinary Oncology)

#### Registered Specialist Veterinary Oncologist

#### Fellow of the Australian and New Zealand College of Veterinary Scientists

Dr. Sonya graduated from veterinary science at the University of Sydney in 2004. After a brief period as a primary care clinician in Hong Kong, she returned to Sydney to embark on a medicine internship at ARH in 2007. From 2008 to 2015, she served as an emergency veterinarian. Dr. Sonya developed an interest in oncology after returning from maternity leave and began dedicating time to ARH's oncology department, leading to the commencement of a veterinary oncology residency in early 2016. In late 2020, she become a fellow of the Veterinary Oncology chapter of the Australian and New Zealand College of Veterinary Scientists.

Dr. Sonya is fascinated by cancer biology, recognising the significant parallels between cancers in humans and companion animals and the potential for cross-species advancements in cancer knowledge, and continuously seeks opportunities to contribute to this dynamic field.

# Dr Catherine Chang

BVSc (Hons) (Melb), FANZCVS (Onc), ACVIM (Onc), Veterinarian

Dr Catherine Chang is a female Veterinarian.

Dr Catherin Chan completed her veterinary studies with honours in Veterinary Medicine at The University of Queensland in 2009. Following her graduation, Catherine embarked on her professional journey by undertaking a small animal internship at Veterinary Specialist Services in 2010. She subsequently gained experience in both emergency and general practice settings before relocating to Sydney in 2012. There, she pursued a three-year residency in Veterinary Oncology, receiving comprehensive training from accomplished board-certified oncologists and participating in specialized programs at the University of Missouri and Colorado State University. Catherine’s expertise in veterinary oncology is recognized and certified by both the American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine (ACVIM) and the Australian and New Zealand College of Veterinary Scientists (ANZCVS).

Presently Catherine holds the role of director and consultant at The Pet Oncologist, an online veterinary oncology consultancy service. Additionally, she provides valuable oncology referral services at North Coast Veterinary Specialist & Referral Centre. Catherines dedication lies in the treatment of various types of cancer in pets. She prioritizes patient care and extends support to families whose beloved pets are battling cancer. Her unwavering commitment includes actively seeing ways to enhance remission and survival rates for pets with cancer while ensuring an excellent quality of life throughout their treatment.

  * ### Specialist Care

At ARC Vets, we accept referrals from veterinary clinics throughout New Zealand and provide specialist care in state-of-the-art facilities. We know that specialist visits can be overwhelming, and we’re here to make the entire experience as smooth and supportive as possible.

  * ### Before Your Appointment

Once we’ve received your referral, our friendly team will contact you to schedule an appointment with the right specialist. We’ll explain the preparation steps to make sure your visit goes smoothly.

  * ### During Your Visit

You and your pet will be welcomed into our purpose-built facility, which features separate areas for dogs and cats to reduce stress. Our specialists will carefully review your pet’s medical history, perform a thorough exam, and discuss a treatment plan that works for both you and your pet.

  * ### After Your Appointment

Once your pet is discharged, we’ll check in to monitor their recovery. Remote follow-up appointments may also be an option if your pet’s condition allows. We are here to support you and ensure the best possible care for your pet at every stage.
